grammarFocus: there be；可数与不可数名词；some / any；地点介词复习。
title: A New Flat Near the Park
instructions: 这是为A2学习者设计的听力练习，主题是住所与生活环境。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答10个问题。问题包括单选、填空和判断正误。填空答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定字数。所有题目均为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
transcript:
M: Hi, Lucy. How is your new flat? 
W: It's nice, thanks. But there are some problems. 
M: Oh? What problems? 
W: Well, there is a big park near my flat. That's good. But there isn't a supermarket near here. 
M: Really? Is there a shop? 
W: Yes, there is a small shop, but it only sells drinks and snacks. There isn't any bread or milk. 
M: That's not good. What about the flat? Is there a balcony? 
W: No, there isn't a balcony. But there are two windows in the living room. 
M: Are there any chairs? 
W: Yes, there are some chairs, but there isn't a table. 
M: No table? How do you eat? 
W: I eat on the sofa. It's OK. 
M: Is there a bed? 
W: Yes, there is a bed in the bedroom. And there are some books on the shelf. 
M: Good. Is there a bus stop near your flat? 
W: Yes, there is a bus stop in front of the park. It's very near. 
M: That's good. Are there any restaurants? 
W: No, there aren't any restaurants near here. But there is a café next to the shop. 
M: A café? Nice. Is the café expensive? 
W: No, it's cheap. A coffee is only two pounds. 
M: Great. So, are you happy in your new flat? 
W: Yes, I am. The park is beautiful, and the people are friendly. 
M: Good. Maybe I can visit you next week. 
W: Sure! But remember, there isn't a table, so we can't have dinner at my flat. 
M: Ha! OK. We can go to the café.

questions.explanation: 录音中Lucy说“there is a big park near my flat”，所以正确答案是A big park。
questions.evidence: there is a big park near my flat

questions.prompt: What does the small shop sell?
questions.explanation: Lucy说小店“only sells drinks and snacks”，所以选Drinks and snacks。
questions.evidence: it only sells drinks and snacks

questions.prompt: Is there a balcony in Lucy's flat?
questions.explanation: Lucy明确说“No, there isn't a balcony”，因此答案是否定的。

questions.prompt: How many windows are there in the living room?
questions.explanation: Lucy说“there are two windows in the living room”，所以是两扇窗户。
questions.evidence: there are two windows in the living room

questions.prompt: What is NOT in the flat?
questions.explanation: 录音中提到有床、有椅子，但“there isn't a table”，所以没有桌子。

questions.prompt: Where is the bus stop? It is in front of the ______.
questions.explanation: Lucy说公交站在公园前面：“in front of the park”，所以填park。
questions.evidence: there is a bus stop in front of the park

questions.prompt: How much is a coffee at the café? It is only ______ pounds.
questions.explanation: 录音中说“A coffee is only two pounds”，所以填two。
questions.evidence: A coffee is only two pounds

questions.prompt: Are there any restaurants near Lucy's flat?
questions.explanation: Lucy说“No, there aren't any restaurants near here”，所以附近没有餐馆。
questions.evidence: No, there aren't any restaurants near here

questions.explanation: Lucy说咖啡馆在商店旁边：“there is a café next to the shop”，所以选Next to the shop。
questions.evidence: there is a café next to the shop

questions.prompt: Why can't they have dinner at Lucy's flat?
questions.explanation: Lucy说“there isn't a table, so we can't have dinner at my flat”，原因是没有桌子。
questions.evidence: there isn't a table, so we can't have dinner at my flat

vocabulary.example: there isn't a supermarket near here
it only sells drinks and snacks
there are some books on the shelf
there is a bus stop in front of the park
there is a café next to the shop

grammar.title: There be 句型与可数/不可数名词
grammar.explanation: 我们用 there is 加单数名词或不可数名词，用 there are 加复数名词。some 用于肯定句，any 用于否定句和疑问句。地点介词如 near, in front of, next to 用来描述位置。
grammar.example: there is a big park near my flat

questions.prompt: There ______ a book on the desk.
questions.evidence: there is a bed in the bedroom

questions.prompt: There ______ some apples in the basket.
There isn't ______ milk in the fridge.
questions.evidence: There isn't any bread or milk.

questions.explanation: next to 表示“在……旁边”，符合句意。
questions.evidence: there is a café next to the shop

• what your favourite room is like
• and why you like that room

Are there any shops near your home?
Do you like your neighbourhood? Why?
What would you like to change about your home?

transfer.writing: Write a short paragraph (about 50 words) about your home. Use there is/are, some/any, and prepositions of place.
